import unittest
from pricing import discounted
from checkout import total
from receipt import receipt
class PricingTests(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_rounding_and_callers(self):
  self.assertEqual(discounted(7,25),5)
  self.assertEqual(total([(7,2)],25),10)
  self.assertEqual(receipt([(7,2)],25),[10])
 def test_invalid(self):
  with self.assertRaises(ValueError): discounted(7,110)
